title: Super cute; very wobbly!!
text: Super cute; very wobbly!!. I love the look of this tray. The white looks clean and crisp and it was easy to assemble. It’s SO WOBBLY THOUGH!! I will have to take it apart and apply wood glue to all the dowels and hopefully that will strengthen it a little.
